thread:
emma - CSM: Morning team — bluecliff go-live in two weeks. Quick sync on VPC/KMS/IAM/audit log handoff? Need to surface blockers and any renewal risks.
raj - Cloud Eng: Got it. Are we still expecting customer to provide a cross-account role for ingestion into their SIEM?
maria - Security Eng: Yes, and we need the KMS key policy to include our service principal before we enable log forwarding. Ben, can you confirm who on Bluecliff will approve key policy changes?
ben - Bluecliff: Hi all — I'll be the approver. I need a sample policy + the minimum permissions we need. Can we avoid giving full decrypt on the key?
sophie - Solutions: Short answer: we only need Encrypt/Decrypt for envelope ops from the inference runtime and Rotate/Describe for ops. We'll also create a restricted rotation role.
emma - CSM: @raj @maria can you post the sample policy and the IAM trust snippet here so Ben can share with his infra team?
raj - Cloud Eng: Pasting a minimal trust JSON for cross-account role (edit for your account id):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Bluecliff-Ingest" },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```
raj - Cloud Eng: And KMS key policy snippet we recommend (grant to redwood-service principal + Bluecliff admin):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service" },
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
maria - Security Eng: Also need audit log target — do you want logs pushed to your S3 bucket or to our central logging VPC via VPC peering? Each has different retention/compliance implications.
ben - Bluecliff: Prefer S3 -> their SIEM pulls. Retention 3 years. We'll provide bucket arn and an ingest role.
sophie - Solutions: Ok, then next steps: (1) Ben to share bucket ARN + approver email, (2) Raj to send final policy with account IDs, (3) Maria to validate retention & lifecycle config for compliance. I'll capture these in the enablement doc.
emma - CSM: On renewal risk — finance flagged that Bluecliff's contract renewal is due right after go-live. If onboarding slips >1 week we risk escalation. Who owns contingency for the go-live date?
raj - Cloud Eng: I'll own infra deliverables. If we hit a blocker on key approvals, we can enable a temporary customer-supplied key with a short-term allowlist so we don't block rollout. Need sign-off from security.
maria - Security Eng: Temporary keys ok for 72 hours with explicit SOX audit log. We'll require rotation after import. I'll issue a short runbook for ops.
ben - Bluecliff: That contingency sounds acceptable. I'll push for approvals but appreciate the fallback.
emma - CSM: Action items summarized: *Ben* — share bucket ARN + approver contact by EOD today; *Raj* — produce final policy with IDs by tomorrow 11am PT; *Maria* — publish temporary-key runbook and retention checklist by tomorrow EOD. Sophie will update the enablement doc and add the rollback steps.
onboard-bot: Reminder set — "Bluecliff KMS/IAM/Logs deliverables" due 2039991350.
sophie - Solutions: I'll add a short FAQ for the customer's infra team (how to approve keys, who to ping for emergency rotation).
emma - CSM: Great. If no blockers after Raj's policy, we'll schedule the handoff call Thurs 10am PT. Ben — does that work?
ben - Bluecliff: Yes, Thurs 10am works. Thanks all.
raj - Cloud Eng: noted. I'll post the final JSON and an annotated diff to the repo.
maria - Security Eng: logging a quick note: ensure S3 bucket has object lock disabled for redwood writes (we need lifecycle control). I'll validate once ARN provided.
emma - CSM: Thanks team — catching up in thread for any late updates. :thumbsup:
